answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can place trades, then slash that bond when an independent audit proves it fabricated activity or colluded across identities. Give each account a capped influence, so splitting one agent into many orchard, terrace, or tundra accounts does not multiply its voting or reward share. A sybil attacker must therefore lock real capital for every identity and risks losing it; creating names is cheap, but sustaining many credible, active accounts is not.
